topic: Task-callable RPCs are no longer listed in one place
detail: From the SP-081 security review (low): letting queued tasks call an RPC (taskRPC) is a security decision that now sits beside each handler instead of in one reviewed list. Proposed: review diffs for 'taskRPC(', or add a test that lists the task-callable RPCs so widening shows as a change to that one test (a shared line again, but one that rarely changes).
